purpose: Defines the logical data model of doc-link: identity, relations, versions and primary sources of information, without specifying a physical schema.
summary: Model boundary: current files versus last committed index are separate; no notification state is held
Table of logical information: document identity, target spec, observation, document info, reference description, check result, section entry, last check state, committed ToC, build run
Document info is stored once per doc_link_id and shared by all keys, never copied per key
Committed ToC holds membership, references, reflected hashes and check results but not document info
Multiplicity: a document may belong to many keys; at most one committed ToC per key
Reverse references are derived only from scanned sources, not a global list
Sections are identified by DLIDs at heading ends; headings are not permanent IDs
Document ID differs from content hash; reference check results hold only for the recorded directory and time
Documents leaving the Index target are removed from the committed ToC without searching outside
tasks: Designing or reviewing doc-link data structures
Deciding what information belongs to document info versus the committed ToC
Implementing reference checks and section entries
Reasoning about freshness of ToC and reference check results
title: DES-003 論理データモデル
